children: SAN DIEGO, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL) ("QuidelOrtho"), a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, announced today that it will issue a press release to report its financial results for the third quarter 2026 ended September 27, 2026, shortly after the market closes at 4:00 p.m. ET on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

Following the release, QuidelOrtho will hold a conference call and webcast beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss its financial results. Interested parties can access the live webcast on the "Investor Relations" page of the Company's website at
. A replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the event on the Company's website.
QuidelOrtho is dedicated to advancing diagnostics to power a healthier future. For more information, please visit
and follow QuidelOrtho on LinkedIn, Facebook and X.

With expertise spanning clinical chemistry, immunoassay, immunohematology and molecular testing, QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL) is a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, dedicated to advancing fast, accurate and reliable results that help improve patient outcomes – from the point of care to hospital, lab to clinic. Building on a legacy of innovation, QuidelOrtho works with healthcare providers to advance diagnostics that connect insights with solutions, defining a clearer path for informed decisions and better care.
Senior Corporate Communications and PR Manager
